main_body: palm tree with canopy and trunk
top_band: light yellow-green top of palm canopy across rows 3-7
evidence: In the central column above the trunk, the upper surface of the palm canopy spans rows 3-7 in bright/mid green, transitioning through darker shaded lower fronds (rows 8-9) to the shaded top of the trunk/coconuts at rows 10-12 and the vertical trunk down to row 37.

style.evidence: The candidate uses 5 shading steps on both the green fronds and brown trunk with dark brown/green material outlines, and segmented bark texture. However, compared to the lush, sprawling Beodeul reference trees with organic root flares, the palm trunk ends in a completely flat horizontal cut at row 37 and the overall canopy silhouette and frond detailing are noticeably stiffer and sparser.
